name: astra-vocab-memory-design-101
decision: GO private TP16 component A/B design; conditional GO private shard-only Model after component/loader/link gates. NO claim of capacity or performance qualification.

linked_proof.constructor_chain: registered KimiK3ForConditionalGenerationHeadR8341 -> TextCausalLMHeadR8341 -> last PP stage DualVocabHeadR8341 -> ReplicatedLinear base; TP16 returns before candidate creation
linked_proof.strength: strong source/build-receipt/manifest chain; not a new runtime pointer or tensor-allocation inspection
remaining: On next isolated private create expose per-owner actual model/head type, global/local weight shapes and bytes, TP rank and PP stage, DSO path/hash and dependency hashes. No raw runtime handshake data.
Preserve full parameter key coverage and prove loaded shard rows by checksum or selected entries against the same source head.
Inspect fresh dependency files/link map for every TU referencing changed concrete types; current RankWorker sizeof proof alone does not establish head/model ABI.

memory.preload_failure: constructor succeeded then all-owner reserve assertion before loading; all owners normal worker shutdown; not evidence of OOM or model impossibility
memory.PP4_snapshot_phase: loading_weights; all64 preload floor 34391195648 bytes; no new model performance result

component_AB.topology: TP16 two nodes x 8 GPUs, actual rank.comm and production IBext_v8 setup in a separately authorized idle allocation; do not co-run on protected live owners
component_AB.B: VocabParallelR8296 ColumnParallelLinear BF16 shard plus full-logits allgather, rank-major to row-major contiguous reorder and existing sync fence
component_AB.weight_input: same actual lm_head weights preferred, same hidden samples if available; else seeded synthetic BF16 input/weight explicitly tagged synthetic, never a model-quality result
component_AB.execution: isolated same-load A/B objects (temporary full+shard acceptable for component only), identical replicated hidden inputs on all 16 ranks; warm up all M; >=30 paired ABBA blocks with per-block barriers outside timer; report p50/p95 and paired uncertainty
timing: end-to-end host wall through output ready, max across TP ranks; include fence/launch overhead
device/stream events for GEMM, allgather, reorder, and combined interval; account for separate CCL stream dependency if any
cold constructor/loading peak separately from warm steady state; no host copy hidden inside head timing; measure CAPI transfer separately
correctness: full BF16 shape/layout/finite checks; rank-slice boundary sentinels and global vocab order

max absolute/relative error, normalized L2, top-k overlap, top1 disagreements classified by BF16 logit margin; thresholds pre-registered after representative baseline variability; no bitidentity/F64 gate
same BF16 inputs and original baseline; altered tokens allowed if quality benchmark does not materially regress
memory: per-owner free/used after create, after load, post-warm and peak M64; allocator reserved/live/workspace separately if exposed
dual component reports cannot establish production savings; separate A-only/B-only fresh-process construction for bytes/peak
network: actual selected transport/plugin and communicator TP16, two-node collective p50/p95, bytes, failures
IB port counters before/after where accessible; do not infer GDR from plugin name; cannot call 20MiB output bytes measured wire traffic
component_AB.go: all ranks/layout/finite/loader checks pass; no unexplained large errors or outlier stalls; full head-wall measurement recorded for all M. For perf adoption require aggregate paired improvement beyond noise; for capacity experiment allow measured bounded slowdown only as explicit tradeoff pending full Model throughput/card.

private_model.storage: new shard-only head type derived from ColumnParallelLinear or composition; never inherit ReplicatedLinear and never retain a full GPU weight clone
minimal_surface: new private causal-LM template binds lm_head to shard-only type on last PP stage and retains parameter key language_model.lm_head.weight
private head/model host TU replaces exactly existing head.o; preserve other current objects and CAPI full BF16 logits
prefer fresh concrete class/template names to avoid ODR clashes; keep factory model key only in isolated DSO registry and avoid duplicate registrations
dependency/nm/link-map audit identifies all concrete-type users; recompile those TUs with identical headers/ABI flags; changed shared_ptr type having same sizeof is not sufficient proof
private_model.loader: ColumnParallel Weight must accept global CPU BF16 [163840,7168] and copy only rows [tp_rank*10240,(tp_rank+1)*10240). Prove the existing loader contract before integration; if it stages full GPU tensor, use bounded CPU slicing to local weight and explicit local-shape contract in private path. CPU full tensor is allowed; second full GPU head is not. Keep source CPU buffers alive until copy fence, and prove each rank owns exactly one slice with no transpose or double-shard.
ABI: keep exported C signatures, BF16 dtype and complete logits semantics
remove/disable old policy setter for shard-only path or report unsupported honestly; it must not claim baseline switching without full weight
eager-only explicit failure if graph capture attempted; preserve owner Runtime, borrowed communicator lifetime, exception drain and destruction order
CPU symbol/layout checks plus one private constructor/load/forward/destroy test; old RankWorker ABI check does not certify new Model type
capacity_go: verify all owner types/shapes/keys and private DSO SHA at actual create
all32 reserve >4GiB after constructor, loader flush/finish, warmup and longest supported context/workspace peak; record any transient loading peak
32-target PP2C16 test uses frozen 93-layer ranges/config/cache topology; fresh create/destroy/post-empty, no OOM/CCL errors
quality reasonable first, then fixed comparable benchmark; accept different token sequences; no obvious quality drop

full model comparison of PP2 target32+draft1 and PP4 target64+draft1 at stated concurrency, request lengths, accepted output tokens, wall-clock and useful tokens/card/second; user per-request15+ criterion must be measured, never inferred from head speed

distributed_argmax.priority: separate follow-up, not blocker for first fullgather head
distributed_argmax.why: pair/batch current flags=3 and full BF16 logits are ABI requirements; token-only flag in legacy forward avoids CPU copy, not current GPU head collective
requirements: new explicit token-only capability, global vocab-offset pair reduction with deterministic tie and NaN policy
sampler processors and penalties before reduction; sampling/top-p needs global distribution semantics and cannot use local argmax
speculative acceptance path must prove it requires only target tokens; paths needing probabilities/full logits retain fullgather
all owners receive globally selected IDs; preserve EOS, mixed lengths, state replay, rejection/commit semantics
distributed_argmax.network_note: 20MiB is result footprint at M64; ring receive is18.75MiB/rank with comparable send; actual algorithm and cross-node traffic must be measured.

cache_decouple.priority: fallback if shard-only still fails measured memory/throughput; not simultaneous first change
cache_decouple.reason: logical C16 currently physical32/pool33 and C32 physical64/pool65 support speculative state; shrinking blindly can violate per-request live/shadow/replay invariants
cache_decouple.required: derive high-water memory by cache kind/layer and actual active states, prove lazy allocation/slot reuse plus rollback and longest context before a private experiment
cache_decouple.trimMemory: already implemented and called in worker PREPROCESS/prepare/reset; not new optimization
cache_decouple.reserve: do not lower 4GiB safety gate to manufacture pass

roofline.FLOPs_total_head: 2*M*7168*163840; shard work per rank is /16, replicated baseline repeats full work on every TP rank
roofline.bandwidth: per-rank weights2240MiB ->140MiB, streaming arithmetic intensity approximately M FLOPs/byte ignoring cache and activations
roofline.latency_model: optimistic head floor >= max(F_rank/P_BF16_shape, Q_HBM/B_effective) plus critical nonoverlapped collective/reorder/launch costs; measure overlap, caching and algorithm
roofline.limits: BF16 actual shape throughput and collective measurements are empirical operating references, not chip physical peak. DenseTF or read-HBM-only microbench cannot establish model physical roofline; require verified chip specs, dtype/path, MoE active routing/expert bytes, cache reads, network and PP schedule. Do not invent numerical hardware peak.
roofline.model_bound: end-to-end useful accepted tokens divided by total participating GPUs and wall time, with draft included; account for PP bubble, latency, concurrency and quality; head-only16x work reduction is not model16x speedup.
